key_features: Robust 5KG Load Capacity: Heavy-duty carbon steel frame easily supports compact ultrabooks and thick gaming laptops.
Ergonomic Multi-Angle Adjustment: Customizes height and viewing angles to reduce neck strain, eye fatigue, and back stiffness.
Enhanced Heat Dissipation Vents: Built-in cutout ventilation slots increase natural airflow to prevent device overheating.
Anti-Slip Silicone Cushioning: Soft rubber pads on the top plate and bottom base prevent scratch damage and surface sliding.
Space-Saving Foldable Design: Folds flat into a compact 1.6kg profile for easy transportation between home and office.
Premium Metallic Finish: Available in sleek silver and grey tones that complement modern laptops and desktop aesthetics.
